exemplars.title: Data Has Entered the Chat: How Data Workers Conduct Exploratory Visual Analytic Conversations with GenAI Agents
exemplars.why: The Thread panel turns modifications into a navigable history whose prior entries can be reopened and refined, providing the clearest evidence of the pattern’s defining return-and-continue operation.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It outranks Smartboard because the evidence explicitly supports continuing work from a historical record, whereas Smartboard demonstrates synchronized rollback but not subsequent refinement.

exemplars.title: Curompt: A Spatially Situated Interface for Generative AI in 3D Design Software
exemplars.why: Per-object chat logs retain local change provenance while a global timeline makes every AI action revertible, combining addressable records with consequential workspace restoration.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It outranks Smartboard because its complementary local and global histories expose both what changed and a workspace-wide rollback mechanism, making the design more transferable than a domain-specific tactic-state tree.

exemplars.title: Towards Human-AI Collaboration for Misapplication Detection in Programming Exercises
exemplars.why: Its class-wide timeline supports inspection at any recorded point and variable-speed replay, offering the strongest direct realization of the pattern’s temporal-traversal operation.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It displaces Smartboard because explicit variable-speed playback covers a required part of the structural signature that Smartboard’s selectable rollback tree does not demonstrate.

notes: I promoted rid 14005 over consensus-ranked rid 11931 to ensure the final set covers explicit chronological playback; the two higher selections already provide stronger evidence for restoration and, in rid 10412, continuation. No score was adjusted by more than 0.3. The set should not be read as proving every clause of the signature in every exemplar: rid 10412 does not explicitly establish playback or cross-session persistence; rid 14039 does not explicitly show playback or continued work after reversion; and rid 14005 is retrospective and does not support resuming or branching from a past state. Evidence for the first two also comes from figure text rather than a fuller interaction account.
